# fortiappseccloud_waf_cookie_security

Configures cookie security for one FortiAppSec Cloud application using the static app endpoint `/waf/apps/{ep_id}/cookie_security`. Set `template = false` and provide `configs` to manage settings directly. Set `template = true` and omit `configs` to inherit this module from the application's attached WAF template.

Declare only one `fortiappseccloud_waf_cookie_security` resource for an application endpoint. Template-level settings are managed by `fortiappseccloud_waf_template_cookie_security`.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "fortiappseccloud_waf_cookie_security" "example" {
  ep_id    = fortiappseccloud_waf_app.example.ep_id
  template = false

  configs {
    status            = true
    action            = "alert_deny"
    mode              = "signed"
    replay_protection = true
    max_age           = 180
    secure_cookie     = true
    http_only         = true
    samesite          = false
    samesite_value    = "Lax"

    cookie_except_list {
      item {
        name     = "__utma"
        wildcard = false
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

- `ep_id` (Required, Forces replacement) — Application endpoint ID. Import uses this exact value and it must contain a non-whitespace character.
- `template` (Required) — Whether effective configuration is inherited from the attached template.
- `configs` (Block) — Required when `template = false` and forbidden when `template = true`. State keeps this block null when template inheritance is enabled.
  - `action` (Optional, Computed) — Sets Action. One of `alert`, `alert_deny`, `deny_no_log`, `remove_cookie`. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `http_only` (Optional, Computed) — Controls Http only for cookie security. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `max_age` (Optional, Computed) — Sets Max age. Between 0 and 65535. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `mode` (Optional, Computed) — Sets Mode. One of `encrypted`, `no`, `signed`. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `replay_protection` (Optional, Computed) — Controls Replay protection for cookie security. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `samesite` (Optional, Computed) — Controls Samesite for cookie security. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `samesite_value` (Optional, Computed) — Sets Samesite value. One of `Lax`, `None`, `Strict`. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `secure_cookie` (Optional, Computed) — Controls Secure cookie for cookie security. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `status` (Optional, Computed) — Enables or disables cookie security. Omission preserves the current value.
  - Collection ownership — Each block below contains ordered `item` blocks. Omitting a collection block preserves the complete raw remote array and keeps the block null in state. A present empty block sends `[]`. A present block with items replaces the complete array in Terraform order.
    - `cookie_except_list` (Optional Block, at most 64 items) — Owns the ordered `cookie_except_list.item` blocks.
      - `cookie_except_list.item.name` (Required, maximum 127 UTF-8 characters) — Rule name.
      - `cookie_except_list.item.wildcard` (Optional, Computed) — Wildcard. Defaults to `false` for a newly configured item.

The wire-only `idx` field is never exposed. The provider regenerates sequential one-based indices independently for each list, validates imported or owned response indices, and sorts state by `idx`. Unknown nested item keys fail closed for owned and imported arrays; omitted top-level collection wrappers remain opaque and are preserved unchanged.


## Import

Import using the application `ep_id`:

```shell
terraform import fortiappseccloud_waf_cookie_security.example application-endpoint-id
```

The first read after import hydrates all ownership wrappers when `template = false`.

## Destroy Behavior
Destroy performs a fresh GET, preserves the complete response, sets `template=false` and `configs.status=false`, sends the complete PUT, and verifies the normalized GET response before Terraform removes the resource from state.
